title: eludite/razor/html
description: Host-to-shell request (brief 0079, ADR-0015): the Razor cohost extension in the Roslyn language server asked for the HTML part of a Razor document (`.razor`, `.cshtml`): HTML completion, hover, formatting and the rest. The host relays it with the document's HTML projection as Razor last published it (`razor/updateHtml`). The shell answers from its HTML language server on a virtual document `<Razor path>__virtual.html` holding `text` (positions in the projection are the Razor document's), with every occurrence of that virtual document's uri in the result mapped back to `uri`; or `null` when no HTML server is available, it does not offer `method`, it fails, or `eluditeGeneration` is not current. The host returns the result to Razor unchanged; an error answer or a lost shell is `null` for Razor.

method.description: The LSP method Razor asks the HTML server: textDocument/completion, completionItem/resolve, textDocument/hover, textDocument/signatureHelp, textDocument/definition, textDocument/implementation, textDocument/documentHighlight, textDocument/references, textDocument/prepareRename, textDocument/rename, textDocument/formatting, textDocument/rangeFormatting, textDocument/onTypeFormatting, textDocument/foldingRange, textDocument/documentColor, textDocument/colorPresentation, textDocument/codeAction, codeAction/resolve, textDocument/linkedEditingRange, or one of Visual Studio's textDocument/_vs_* extensions (which a standard HTML server does not offer).

uri.description: The Razor document's uri, as Razor names it.

checksum.description: Razor's checksum of the projection: the shell sends the virtual document's text again only when it changes.

text.description: The whole HTML projection: the Razor document with its C# and Razor parts blanked out, the same length and line structure as the document.

params.description: The LSP params of `method` as Razor built them; `textDocument.uri` names the Razor document (the shell replaces it with the virtual document's).

eluditeGeneration.description: The solution generation current when the host relayed the request.

result.description: The HTML server's LSP result for `method`, or `null`.
